Rows, Jack Heart: "i think we should allow sparsity in WHAT gets logged, but i see little reason to be loose with clocks". Confirms the clock steer (every row carries every clock in use, no sparse-clock switch) and adds: a row may log any subset of metrics, and a metric absent from a row reads as missing (null), never zero or carried forward. Make sure the docs say so and a focused test covers rows with different metric sets on the same clocks.
